AirPods Pro 3 continues to drop to $50 off, AirPods Max 2 by $100, and AirTag 2 maintains its all-time low, but today's main event in 9to5Toys' "Midday Roundup" is the $200 discount on the entry-level 24GB 15-inch M5 MacBook Air, alongside a $500 discount on the M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB configuration. We also have Amazon's highest-quality refurbished iPhone 17 Pro models discounted by up to $220, fleeting summer deals on Apple Watch Series 11 from $299, and the latest Nitro Black Beats 240W braided USB-C cable at Amazon for $18 (40% off), one of the best prices ever. Read on for details.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (regular price $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (regular price $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (regular price $129)
  • AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation) $145 (regular price $179)
  • AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation) $119 (regular price $179 new) — Premium Refurbished

The most affordable 24GB 15-inch M5 MacBook Air is $200 off today, with more deals

AirPods Pro 3 summer deals continue, and we also have a $500 discount on the M5 Pro MacBook Pro, but M5 MacBook Air discounts have been elusive for the past month or so. We started seeing Amazon offer a $100 discount on the new pricing to ease the price hike pressure, but we just discovered this Amazon-exclusive 24GB model at B&H with a significant $200 discount.

Amazon is currently offering $100 off various 13-inch and 15-inch M5 MacBook Air configurations:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,199 (regular price $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,499 (regular price $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,699 (regular price $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,399 (regular price $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,699 (regular price $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,899 (regular price $1,999)

As you can see, Amazon does not sell the official 24GB/1TB 15-inch M5 MacBook Air configuration—the most affordable 24GB model you can buy. However, B&H's Apple authorized reseller has it in stock, currently selling it for $200 below the listed price:

B&H is currently selling the 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 24GB RAM and 512GB storage for $1,499 with free shipping. The original price is $1,699, now $200 below the listed price.

This is one of the best M5 MacBook Air deals we've seen since the official price increase.

If you're looking for a MacBook Pro, we have $400 and $500 discounts on configurations this week, not just limited to the highest-end models:

Get the M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB with $500 off, 48GB models with $400 off, and more deals

Beyond the continued AirPods Pro 3 "Black Friday in July" pricing with $50 off, and the $100 discount on all colors of Apple AirPods Max 2, we're still seeing significant price-hike relief deals on the latest M5 MacBook Pro lineup. Highlights include Amazon's $500 off the listed price on the 24GB/2TB 14-inch M5 Pro model, and B&H's $400 discount on the 48GB model.

This could be said to be the best M5 Pro MacBook Pro deal we've seen since the price hike took effect. Amazon is currently selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro for $2,499 with free shipping. Original price $2,999, this model features 24GB RAM and 2TB built-in storage, $500 below the new listed price.

This deal is particularly appealing because Apple recently raised the price of this configuration by $400, and before that, it had never dropped below $2,340 on Amazon.

Another highlight of this week's MacBook Pro deals is the B&H 48GB/1TB 14-inch M5 Pro model, selling for $2,799 with free shipping. While you pay more for double the RAM, it's also $400 below the $3,199 listed price, and it's a configuration that Amazon simply doesn't carry.

Other MacBook Pro deals we're tracking this week include:

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,699 (regular price $2,019)
  • Comes with Apple 96W USB-C Power Adapter (worth $20)
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,849 (regular price $1,999)
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,049 (regular price $2,199)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,199 (regular price $2,519)
  • Includes 96W Apple Charger upgrade (worth $20)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,299 (regular price $2,499)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,299 (regular price $3,599)
  • 16-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,999 (regular price $4,399)

Amazon is currently selling the most affordable M5 Max MacBook Pro you can buy with $500 off

Amazon's highest-quality refurbished iPhone 17 Pro models discounted by $220, 17 Pro Max up to $450 off

If you want to get your hands on the current generation iPhone 17 Pro or Pro Max at a discount, there are some options this week. While deals on brand new unlocked phones from reputable sources are hard to come by, we're still seeing Amazon's highest-quality refurbished 17 Pros with up to $220 off, while Woot once again offers up to $450 off the 17 Pro Max.

On Amazon's end, 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models are once again selling with up to $220 off—these are Amazon Renewed Premium models, backed by a one-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee, with battery life "higher than original 90%." Standard Amazon refurbished units only come with a 90-day warranty and don't offer the same battery guarantee.

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (regular price $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (regular price $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (regular price $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,199 (regular price $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,199 (regular price $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,199 (regular price $1,299 new)

On Woot's end, however, deals on the larger 17 Pro Max are still going on "brand new, factory-sealed" units, with up to $450 off Apple's listed price, though color options are starting to dwindle:

  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 512GB $1,300 (regular price $1,399)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 1TB $1,450 (regular price $1,599)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 2TB $1,550 (regular price $1,999)

Apple Watch Series 11 summer deals are about to disappear, grab one with $100 off on the most popular models while you still can

While we're still seeing $50 off AirPods Pro 3 for summer, $100 off AirPods Max 2, and the Apple AirTag 4-pack maintaining its all-time low, the most affordable Apple Watch Series 11 deals are starting to disappear. If you're interested in upgrading your Apple wearable with $100 off, you'll want to act fast.

Amazon is currently selling the 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 for $299, and the 46mm model for $329 with free shipping. That's $100 off the original prices of $399 and $429 respectively, and they're the most affordable models you can buy.

However, color options for these deals are starting to dwindle. There are still some colors available at the discounted price, but it looks like Series 11's summer discounts are starting to either go out of stock or return to full price this week.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (regular price $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (regular price $429)

Latest Nitro Black Beats 240W braided USB-C cable drops to $18 (40% off) at Amazon

While we've been tracking the latest Beats 240W braided USB-C cable in Nitro Navy blue selling for $18 and $19 (37% off) for some time, Amazon just dropped the 10-foot black version to one of its best prices ever, with Prime members getting free shipping for just over $18.

Twelve South launches new leather Valet accessory tray with Qi2 25W MagSafe charging

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Anker 200W charging station with six ports, now only $56 (2026 new low)
  • This 3-foot PU leather desk pad is now shipping for under $13 with Prime
  • Upgrade your office with a monitor arm, now only $20 (38% off)
  • Anker's flagship 14-port Prime expansion dock supports triple display output, drops to $228 for "Black Friday in July"
  • Twelve South's PlugBug wall charger with built-in Find My drops to $40, new Amazon low
  • Elevation Lab's waterproof AirTag fabric mount drops to $8 each
  • Apple Home integration features lead meross dual-zone Wi-Fi smart water hose timer, now $80 (Amazon new low)
  • This MagSafe accessory adds grip and stand functionality to your iPhone, priced at $15 (regular $20)
  • This compact 70W charger is now just $20 to power your laptop, phone, and more (all-time low)
  • Already affordable Grade 5 titanium Apple Watch drops in price again, black or silver now $56 (down $20)

AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation) now as low as $119 at Amazon, more models from $99

Summer sales and "Black Friday in July" deals on the current generation AirPods lineup continue this week. We're still seeing AirPods Pro 3 at $50 below the listed price, and all colors of AirPods Max 2 are $100 off. Additionally, we continue to see the best prices in months on AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation), plus Amazon Renewed Premium refurbished units as low as $119.

Amazon is selling Apple AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation) for $144.99 with free shipping. Original price $179, that's 20% below the listed price, the best deal since March.

Note that you can also get the Amazon Renewed Premium version for $119—this unit comes with a one-year warranty, offering the best refurbished quality Amazon provides.

For some people, unless you specifically want the AirPods 4 form factor, paying $55 more for AirPods Pro 3 during the sale period would be a better choice, but we'll still track significant discounts on each model, regardless of which one you want.
